verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions running inside Zendesk, Salesforce or Intercom, or any two-way ticket sync. The nearest items are adjacent rather than direct: multi-channel deployment (chat, phone, email), Live Assist updating customer context for reps, and an MCP gateway connecting agents to internal tools. None of these shows a helpdesk integration with bidirectional ticket and context sync.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways
